images.prompt:
Hand-painted festive gouache and coloured-pencil illustration on subtly textured cold-press paper, with fine selective pencil outlines, softly simplified storybook forms and crisp decorative details. Full colour in deep cobalt and inky navy, frosted blue-grey, soft cream, muted berry red and warm amber; gentle tonal shading, dry-brush texture, subtle crosshatching and cosy luminous accents. Refined, nostalgic adult Christmas-card mood, with a clear focal hierarchy and generous calm space for elegant serif typography; home-print friendly contrast and restrained ink coverage.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil festive illustration with a refined, nostalgic storybook finish for an adult Christmas card.; line weight: Fine selective pencil outlines, softened by opaque gouache edges.; line quality: Gently imperfect, hand-drawn and crisp in small decorative details.; detail level: Moderate detail with intricate focal accents, simplified surrounding forms and generous calm areas for seasonal wording.; background density: Layered but restrained; atmospheric detail recedes softly to preserve a clear focal hierarchy and open text space.; composition: Clear central focal hierarchy with a broad uncluttered area for elegant greeting typography; balanced vertical flow and quiet negative space.; palette: Deep cobalt and inky navy balanced with warm amber, soft cream, muted berry red and frosted blue-grey neutrals.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Gentle tonal gouache shading, subtle coloured-pencil crosshatching and warm illuminated accents against cool shadow.; texture: Visible cold-press paper grain, dry-brush snow texture and lightly waxy coloured-pencil marks.; mood: Cosy, hopeful, intimate and quietly nostalgic..

PAGE 1 of "Starlit Village Post" (card-front): Card front: small snow-covered village post office in the lower centre beneath an expansive cobalt winter sky; glowing muted berry-red letter box in the foreground, warm amber windows, softly layered snowy hills, three cream envelopes lifting upward and changing into tiny golden stars. Keep broad open upper-sky space for refined serif title text exactly: “Christmas Wishes”.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with an illustrated background that is part of the artwork. The artwork runs to every edge (full bleed). Keep all text and key elements inside a comfortable inner safe area. It must look like a finished, retail-quality greeting card design, not a colouring page or worksheet. Design as a portrait folded card set with coordinated front, inside and back panels, preserving clear central space for the inside message and fold-safe alignment. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copied or recognisable branded Christmas-card artwork, characters, logos or distinctive compositions; Photorealism or glossy 3D rendering; Overly childish cartoon styling; Dense clutter that competes with the greeting; Harsh neon colours or heavy black shadows; Unreadable, misspelled or distorted typography; Dark full-bleed backgrounds likely to print poorly at home.
